title: Existing ringed-site tensor functors and resolving representative comparison
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site essentially small in a coefficient universe $r$, and let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings with values in that universe. Write $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ for the category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define $\operatorname{ordinaryTensor}_R:\mathcal A\to\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal A,\mathcal A)$ to be the curried sheafified tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and $\operatorname{totalTensor}_R$ to be its curried signed direct-sum total tensor on integer-indexed cochain complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Given a localization universe for $D(R)$, define $\operatorname{derivedTensor}_R$ to be the currying of the derived tensor selected by [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent], with precisely that theorem's selected homotopy and resolving comparison isomorphisms. For K-flat complexes $A,B$ [def-pc-kflat-complex] whose terms are flat module sheaves [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], define
$$\operatorname{representativeIso}_{A,B}:Q_R\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes_R B)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{derivedTensor}_R(Q_RA,Q_RB)$$
as the composite of the inverse under $Q_R$ of the selected homotopy-total comparison at $(A,B)$, followed by the selected resolving comparison at their images in the full subcategory of flat-term K-flat complexes. These are abbreviations for the existing module category and tensor functors, together with the comparison from the same selected descent data; no new tensor, resolution choice or triangulated-exactness assertion is part of this definition.
